title: Prop configuration
description: Startup configuration, loaded by the interface (C6) at process start. Read by providers (C2), tools (C3), and sessions (C5).

kind.description: Which of the two Prop adapters to use (C2).

base_url.description: Endpoint for the OpenAI-compatible adapter; required when kind is openai-compatible (C2).

api_key.description: Optional bearer credential for the endpoint (C2).

model.description: Fixed model name for the run (C2).

context_window.description: Model context size in tokens, used by context fitting (C4).

sampling.description: Optional sampling parameters for the configured model (C2), sent where the adapter supports them; omitted keys use the endpoint defaults.

workspace_root.description: Root that file tools and run_command are confined to (C3). Defaults to the process working directory when omitted; may be changed during a session via an interface command (C6).

session_dir.description: Directory holding persisted session files (C5). Defaults to <workspace_root>/.sudoer/sessions.

web.description: Network capability for the web tools (C3). Enabled and open by default; a denial is a hard block with no interactive override.

enabled.description: Master switch for web egress. When false the web tools are not assembled at all.

search_url.description: Base URL of the SearXNG (or compatible) backend used by web_search. When absent, web_fetch still works and web_search reports that it is unset.

deny_hosts.description: Hosts egress is blocked from. Empty by default (any host is allowed). An entry is an exact host or a `.`-prefixed suffix.
